{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_completed['revenue_float'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue_float'].mean()

print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f} USD')"}
